# ProtoVid

> A self-serve Figma plugin that turns connected prototype flows into MP4, WebM, or GIF product demo videos, with optional browser-based review rooms for timestamped stakeholder feedback and approval — no screen recording, no editing timeline.

By Das Group LLC. Last updated: 2026-08-19.

## Key facts

- For: designers, product teams, freelancers, and agencies who share Figma prototype walkthroughs with clients or stakeholders.
- Core problem: turning a connected Figma prototype into a shareable demo video without screen recording, cursor cleanup, or post-editing.
- Output formats: MP4 (H.264), WebM, GIF.
- Resolutions: 720p on Free (watermarked); 1080p and 4K on Project Pass and Pro (no watermark).
- Review rooms: browser links with a decision brief, timestamped comments, and approve/request-changes status. Reviewers do not need a Figma account.
- Plugin: Figma Community, runs in the Figma sandbox.
- Version: 1.3.15.

## Pricing

- Free: $0/month — 3 watermarked 720p exports per month. No credit card.
- Project Pass: $4 once — 7 days of unlimited 1080p and 4K exports, no watermark. No subscription.
- Pro: $5/month — unlimited 1080p and 4K exports, no watermark, review rooms, decision briefs, and owner analytics.

## Best for

- App Store and product preview videos
- SaaS landing-page demos
- Client walkthroughs and design reviews
- Portfolio case studies
- Social reels and launch posts
- Investor and stakeholder updates

## Not for

- Screen recording or general video editing
- Interactive prototyping (ProtoVid reads existing prototype connections; it does not build them)
- Static design exports

## Privacy

- Captures only the frames in the selected connected path. Does not scan other files or unrelated frames.
- Encoding happens locally in the plugin when supported.
- Review links expire after 7 days (Free) or 30 days (paid). Expired review data is physically deleted by a daily retention cleanup.
- No external AI account or model connection required for decision briefs.
